name: unifi
description: UniFi Network inventory and alerts. Reads adopted devices from each client's controller, feeds configurations and interfaces, forwards signed alerts, and links a configuration to its device page in the controller that owns it.

controller_url.title: Controller origin
controller_url.description: The controller's own origin, for example https://unifi.example.com. Each client connection names its own controller.

site.title: Site
site.description: The controller site this connection serves, as the controller names it in its URL.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Minted in Network > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations.
